extraction.rule: block lines 21-133 read at the record pin; a numeral token is a maximal digit run with internal '.' or ',' groups (regex \d+(?:[.,]\d+)*|\.\d+) or a number word (zero..twelve, half; case-insensitive, word-bounded). rows.cause: wording (4g C16), partly applied, not the value: the note now names G_c as the natural gap 'on the next-token readout'; N7's qualifiers (the A4 readout; on OLMo almost entirely a gap in the tail level of the distribution; pooled-SD units) are not carried
rows.comment: Carried from v0.3 S3#31 (same unit, same figure); the clause changed. Value reproduced (L113; N7 @09c3a8c:302). C16 (N7 note 7, :289) is PARTLY APPLIED: 'in direction units' is gone and the quantity is named as G_c, a gap on the next-token readout; N7's qualifier that on OLMo G_c is almost entirely a gap in the tail level of the next-token distribution, in pooled-SD units, is not carried. C17 (N7 note 9, :291) is PARTLY APPLIED (revised in round 2 on the checker's finding 1; round 1 said APPLIED): 'sharpens what it inherits' is now 'raises the gap it inherits', which names what rises, and the record's descriptive miss is now mentioned. Residue, for the design seat: (i) note 9's first pass-2 qualifier, that what rises is on OLMo almost entirely a tail-level gap (note 7, :289), is not carried; (ii) its second, that D+/G_c divides readings from two versions of the instrument (note 10's readout caveat, :292), is not carried; (iii) the added clause 'potency per unit of that gap falls along the chain' names neither pole nor dose (note 10's point, :292), and at matched dose the values are not monotone after base: D+/G_c at frac 0.10 is base 0.1097, SFT 0.0219, DPO 0.0257, instruct 0.0232 (N7 :165); at frac 0.40 SFT's D+/G_c exceeds base's (base/sft 0.76x, N7 :177, :179). The record says 'D+/G_c at matched dose is 0.110 at Base against 0.022–0.026 after training' and calls the direction the reverse of 'potency may sharpen along the chain' (RESULTS.md@bbc9ffe:8431-8436). That supports a fall from base, not a fall at every step. A form N7 suggests (note 10, :292): 'the positive-pole displacement per unit G_c at matched dose (frac 0.10) is 4.3–5.0 times larger at base'. Four values belong together; none of them changes.

'A repeated unsteered pass' says which sham and keeps it apart from the B3 sham arm's non-zero pseudo-Deltas, which is what note 11 asks. But 'the extraction's sham' names a stage that has no such control (Code's reading; no item raw routes it). The 16/16 cells are the sham control of the A4 hijack (dose) ladder: N7 :306 source column; LOCK-g.md@bbc9ffe:46-49 ('controls at every tested frac; ≥3 norm-matched randoms + sham'); RESULTS.md@bbc9ffe:8785-8786. PROPOSAL-g names the stages: A3 is the e0 extraction (PROPOSAL-g-ontogeny-of-evaluation.md@bbc9ffe:164), A4 is causal qualification and dose-finding (:172). Forms the record supports: 'the dose ladder's sham' or 'A4's sham'. Line 3's 'the extraction sham vs the choice sham' carries the same label, so the misnaming is in the design seat's framing, not a slip on this line alone.
